title: Muttereralmbahn Mutters
name: Muttereralmbahn Mutters
kurzbeschreibung: The Muttereralmbahn in Mutters: family adventure mountain at 1,608 m above sea level with a mountain cart track, adventure playground, and panoramic lake.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Muttereralmbahn in the charming holiday village of Mutters in the Tiroler Mittelgebirge transports guests in comfortable 8-seater gondolas directly onto the sunny high plateau of the Mutterer Alm at 1,608 metres above sea level. Located just about eight kilometres southwest of the Tyrolean provincial capital Innsbruck, this multifaceted adventure mountain commands a breathtaking panorama over the Inntal, the low mountain terrace, and the striking rocky backdrop of the Nordkette. As a multi-award-winning Tyrolean family mountain, the Mutterer Alm combines nature-oriented leisure activities, eventful hiking paths, and exhilarating downhill adventures for visitors of all generations.

Attractions & Mountain Carts

On the expansive alpine plateau directly surrounding the mountain station, families will discover a lovingly designed adventure playground: a large water play area featuring ponds, wooden rafts, and interactive streams invites splashing and experimenting on warm summer days. Along the low-barrier Zauberwasser-Wanderweg and around the idyllic reservoir lake, comfortable relaxation loungers, wooden treehouses, and shaded resting spots are scattered across the grounds. A signature highlight of the Muttereralmbahn is the spectacular Mountain-Cart-Strecke: along a secured, roughly five-kilometre-long forest route, adventure seekers race downhill from the mountain station into the valley on three-wheeled fun-sport carts swiftly and safely. In addition, the Bikepark Innsbruck at the Muttereralm offers flowy single trails, banked corners, and jumps for mountain bikers of all skill levels.

Visit & Getting There

The Muttereralmbahn is open daily from mid-May to late October between 09:00 and 17:00 during the summer months. Summer cable car round-trip fares (season 2025/2026): adults approx. €24.00, seniors approx. €21.50, children (aged 6 to 15) approx. €14.00; mountain cart rental approx. €15.00 per ride. A round-trip journey is free with the all-inclusive Innsbruck Card. Public transport: a genuine highlight is the ride on the historic Stubaitalbahn (Linie STB) from Innsbruck Hauptbahnhof; the tram winds picturesquely across the mid-mountain terrace to the stop Mutters Nockhofweg / Muttereralmbahn (about a three-minute walk to the valley station). By car: via the Brennerautobahn A13, exit Innsbruck-Süd, continuing on the regional road to Mutters (large paid parking areas are available directly at the valley station).

Tips

The 8-seater gondolas feature step-free level boarding, making them ideal for strollers and wheelchairs; the restaurant Mutterer Alm and the circular path around the reservoir lake are barrier-free. Be sure to plan a downhill run with the mountain carts; on sunny weekends, reserving your carts early at the valley or mountain ticket office is strongly recommended.
